notes.title: Back on track!
notes.content:
Let's be real, the game is just not good.
The game was supposed to be updated more frequently
but unfortunately my files got corrupted shortly after release.
with the original game files gone and me expecting the game to fail,
i decided to quit the project.
until two years ago when people became vocal about this game making me aware of an existing playerbase.

Since then i've been planning a rework on the entire game!
Here is a short list of what you can expect:

-tighter controls/gameplay

-better optimization

-better graphics

-updated audio

-new music

-audio sliders in menu

I'm working hard on finishing the rework but i'm not gonna rush it as this is 
a gift to the players.


Thanks for your patience,

-RCade Softworks

notes.title: Guts over fear
notes.content:
since i forgot to mention that i will still add new stuff to the game even though i already released it let's do that now.

Hi, i will still add content to the the game even though i already released it.
So now i present to you the first update called: “Guts over fear”.
You can check the new features and bugfixes in the changelog below.

I wanna finish by thanking everyone who bought the game this week, hope you guys enjoy the game!

~RCade


Changelog:

Items:

-Nes

Can be obtained by finding a new mystery egg that only spawns on the shrine
floor.

-Cartridges

Cartridges are dropped by the no-man once the player has found an NES.

-Guts

Upon being hit  the player and mobs both drop guts!

Abilities:

-you now can slow down mobs and prevent them from shooting projectiles by pressing "E" once you've collected 2 specific 
cartridges (using this ability in the boss fight will grant you special aid).

Bugfixes

-New title screen music

-Lasers will now disappear when you kill a no-man while he is attacking

-Added missing sounds

-Fixed lag

-Fixed layer issues

-Fixed some more minor Bugs
